trends.name: Iran Conflict Escalation & Market Impact
trends.summary: Houthis officially enter conflict to support Iran as US peace negotiations stall, with no clear US-Israeli strategy. S&P 500 has lost $4.8 trillion since Iran war escalation began, posting lowest close in 232 days. Oil prices surge to highest levels since 2022 as geopolitical risk premium overwhelms cease-fire hopes.

trends.name: Tech Sector Selloff & Valuation Reset
trends.summary: Tech stocks suffer worst week in nearly a year with Microsoft oversold at decade lows and Meta facing sustained legal/regulatory pressure around content moderation and child safety. Wall Street approaching longest losing streak in nearly 4 years as growth slowdown concerns mount.

trends.name: Oil Market Surge & Energy Price Inflation
trends.summary: Oil prices close at highest levels since 2022 with analyst perspectives suggesting $150 is more likely than $50 due to persistent supply concerns. Iran negotiations failing to ease supply fears while market sentiment shows fatigue with fake peace talk headlines.

trends.name: Government Shutdown & TSA Funding Crisis
trends.summary: House GOP rejects Senate DHS funding proposal extending government shutdown with TSA officer payment delays creating airport operational risks. Legislation expected to pass this week but uncertainty continues to weigh on travel sector and government operations.

trends.name: Fed Rate Hike Expectations Decline
trends.summary: JPMorgan economists signal bar for Fed hiking is very high given emerging growth slowdown signals. BOE rate hike expectations rising in UK while US Fed policy appears increasingly dovish despite inflation concerns.

trends.name: Meta Legal Liability & Big Tech Regulation
trends.summary: Meta and Google face mounting legal challenges over social media addiction, child safety, and content moderation. Epstein victims suing Google and Trump administration over personal data disclosure, escalating regulatory and litigation risks for major platforms.

trends.name: Market Correction & Valuation Exhaustion
trends.summary: S&P 500 down 6.7% year-to-date with market breadth deteriorating significantly—only 46% of NYSE stocks above 200-day moving average versus 85% last April. Easy money from cheap risk is over as broader market rotation accelerates.

trends.name: Trump Tariff Strategy & Deficit Impact
trends.summary: Trump claims tariff revenue will fund stimulus checks, but tariff collections represent minimal deficit impact relative to federal spending needs. Potential fiscal stimulus announcements could reignite inflation concerns despite economic slowdown signals.

trends.name: Semiconductor & Memory Chip Volatility
trends.summary: Weebit Nano discusses storage chip advancements amid DRAM industry challenges; Micron analysts caution against calling tops amid cyclical uncertainty. Cybersecurity stocks fall on report of Anthropic testing powerful new AI models, signaling shifting competitive dynamics.

trends.name: Infrastructure & Energy Sector Divergence
trends.summary: iShares Global Infrastructure ETF (IGF) and Utility ETF (XLU) gaining relative strength as defensive positioning accelerates. Energy infrastructure plays benefiting from oil price surge while growth sectors face headwinds from geopolitical uncertainty.

trends.name: Short Seller Opportunity In Equity Market
trends.summary: 16 stocks identified as short seller dreams with downside regardless of broader market direction. Sector-specific weakness in travel (Carnival fuel exposure), tech, and consumer discretionary creating asymmetric downside risk opportunities.

trends.name: Tax Filing & IRS Refund Surge
trends.summary: Average IRS tax refunds up 10.9% with filing season underway, providing consumer cash flow boost. Department of Education announces SAVE plan implementation steps affecting millions of student loan borrowers.
